UI_ImmersiveSnow_FootprintsFrom_tooltip: Whose footprints you see: everyone's, players' only or nobody's (no footprints, no snow off the soles). The lesser of this and the sandbox counts; in single player with "Use these settings instead of the sandbox" this alone. In multiplayer never more than the server has.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_TireTracks_tooltip: Off: no tire tracks and no snow off the tires for you, whatever the sandbox says. Try this first if the game stutters while driving. On: as the sandbox says, in single player with "Use these settings instead of the sandbox" on.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_BloodyTireTracks_toolti: Off: no red tire tracks after running over a corpse for you, whatever the sandbox says. On: as the sandbox says, in single player with "Use these settings instead of the sandbox" on. Also off with the vanilla blood decals off.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_BloodyFootprints_toolti: Off: no red footprints after stepping on a corpse for you, whatever the sandbox says. On: as the sandbox says, in single player with "Use these settings instead of the sandbox" on. Also off with the vanilla blood decals off.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_VehicleHoodMelt_tooltip: Off: no faster melting on the hood of a warm engine for you, whatever the sandbox says; the hood keeps the snow of the rest of the body. On: as the sandbox says, in single player with "Use these settings instead of the sandbox" on. Only on vehicles whose hood is a separate model (KI5, Vanilla Vehicles Animated...). In multiplayer you can hide it for yourself; whether it melts and how fast is the server's.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_FrostScreen_tooltip: Off: no frost creeping in from the edges of your screen in hypothermia, whatever the sandbox says. On: as the sandbox says, in single player with "Use these settings instead of the sandbox" on. In multiplayer you can hide it for yourself; how thick and from which level are the server's.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_VehicleFrost_tooltip: Off: no frost on vehicle windows for you (nothing to scrape, a clear view from inside), whatever the sandbox says. On: as the sandbox says, in single player with "Use these settings instead of the sandbox" on. In multiplayer you can hide it for yourself; how fast it grows and thaws is the server's.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_LowEndMode_tooltip: For weak integrated graphics: no snow on zombies, items and vehicle doors and wheels, no vehicle icing, fewer footprints and tire tracks. Also turned on by the same sandbox option.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_DetailedDecals_tooltip: Three shapes of every footprint and tire track segment, so trails do not repeat. Off: one shape, a third of the video memory for their textures.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_BlowOffSound: Sound of snow flying off vehicles
UI_ImmersiveSnow_BlowOffSound_tooltip: A soft thump and hiss when a layer of snow flies off a vehicle going fast. Heard only by you; zombies do not hear it.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_OwnNote: The same settings as on the sandbox page, but only on your computer. What you turn off here stays hidden for you even with the box below cleared. In multiplayer only the on/off switches work (to hide for yourself what the server has on), every number follows the server.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_UseOwn: Use these settings instead of the sandbox
UI_ImmersiveSnow_UseOwn_tooltip: Single player only. On: the settings below replace the sandbox settings of the save, also in an existing save. Off: the sandbox decides, but what you turn off below stays hidden for you. In multiplayer this box does nothing: what you turn off below is hidden for you, everything else (durations, limits, rates) follows the server; wetness from snow follows the server entirely and cannot be turned off.
UI_ImmersiveSnow_ScrapeFrostHand: Scrape frost off the windows (by hand)
